<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Complaint" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Complaint" name="Complaint filed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Decision" name="Refund decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Refund" name="Refund sent"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Satisfaction feedback"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ComplaintFiled" name="Files complaint" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DecisionNotice" name="Decision notice" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RefundSent" name="Refund sent" sourceRef="Task_SendRefund" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" name="Provides feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_FeedbackReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Complaint Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer Service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ComplaintFiled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ResolveMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FeedbackReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_CaseClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Department" name="Relevant Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InvestigateComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Financial Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ComplaintFiled" messageRef="Msg_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InvestigateComplaint" name="Review details and determine validity and refund justification"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyDecision" name="Notify customer of decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_RefundRejected"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRefund" name="Send refund to customer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResolveMerge" name="Case ready for resolution"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FeedbackReceived" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CaseClosed" name="Case closed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LogToAssign" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToLog" sourceRef="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignToInvestigate" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_InvestigateComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvestigateToNotify" sourceRef="Task_InvestigateComplaint" targetRef="Task_NotifyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToDecision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundRejected" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ResolveMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcessToSend" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Task_SendRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendToMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendRefund" targetRef="Gateway_ResolveMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToResolved" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolveMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResolvedToFeedback" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="Event_FeedbackReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToEnd" sourceRef="Event_FeedbackReceived" targetRef="End_CaseClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
